headline: Recommended approval of signs for The Moon and the Mat, Offerings, and CVS; withdrawn item noted for Landry & Arcari Rugs and Carpeting.
summary: The board reviewed sign applications for The Moon and the Mat at 267 Cabot Street, Offerings at 719 Hale Street, and CVS at 434 Rantoul Street, recommending approval of each with specific conditions. A site plan modification request for Landry & Arcari Rugs and Carpeting at 143 Brimbal Avenue had been previously withdrawn. The board also approved the February 5, 2026 meeting minutes as amended.
decisions: Recommended approval of the sign as presented, option 1, for The Moon and the Mat at 267 Cabot Street, along with any compliant window signage, 5-0.

Recommended approval of the requested replacement projecting sign to be installed in the existing mounting hardware, as presented, along with the proposed Option 1 window signage for the application at 719 Hale Street, applicant Offerings, subject to the plans and images submitted, 5-0.
Recommended approval of the wall sign on the Elliot Street façade, the wall sign on the Rantoul Street façade, and the two wall signs on the pharmacy canopy, for CVS at 434 Rantoul Street, 5-0.
Approved the February 5, 2026 meeting minutes, as amended, 5-0.
